name: IngestWorker

test_list.description: Reopen actual returned CAS references and check exact text, source identity, and source locations.
Malformed, absent, and corrupt source references fail without a success response.
Unconfigured image OCR returns an explicit unsupported error.
Check protocol negotiation, mode separation, eviction, shutdown, and closed admission.
Verify source integrity and the worker-specific decode cap without reflecting document content in statuses.
Busy admission rejects work immediately; shutdown cannot claim drain while the parser permit remains owned.
Grace exhaustion reports a timeout and still signals transport shutdown.
Bound provenance serialization and prevent document-controlled error text from reaching RPC statuses.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: Hash-verified source in explicitly configured bounded CAS.

inputs.name: media_type
inputs.description: Bounded declared format checked alongside content signatures.

output_description: CAS references to normalized Markdown and versioned untrusted provenance, or a typed error.
